title: Manifest
description: manifest.json at the root of a Harness Package, manifestVersion 1. Normative prose: docs/tech/manifest-spec.md.

manifestVersion.description: Version of this Manifest format. This schema describes version 1 only.

id.description: Harness ID, `publisher/slug`. The publisher segment is the Publisher's GitHub login, lower-cased. Immutable for the life of the Harness.

version.description: Harness Version: strict semver (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release, no build metadata). Must be greater than every previously published version.

summary.description: One sentence shown in lists, at most 120 characters.

tags.description: At most 5 tags from the curated list, without duplicates.

homepage.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the Harness's homepage.

sourceRepo.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the source repository, shown as "Source" on the detail page.

channel.description: Channel. Only `stable` exists in P0; `beta` is reserved for P1.

platforms.description: Non-empty list of the platforms the Harness runs on, without duplicates.

entry.title: Entry
entry.description: The command the Runtime executes. `node`: a relative path to a .js, .mjs or .cjs file. `binary`: an object mapping every declared platform to the relative path of an executable.

workspace.description: Whether the Harness asks the User for a Workspace at launch.

changelog.description: Markdown for this version, at most 5 KB (5 120 bytes of UTF-8).

^x-.description: Publisher-private data. Ignored by the Store and the Runtime.

relativePath.description: Path of a file inside the Harness Package, relative to the archive root, with `/` separators and no `.` or `..` segments.

nodeEntryPath.description: A `relativePath` that ends in .js, .mjs or .cjs. Applies to the string form of `entry`.

harnessRuntime.title: HarnessRuntime
harnessRuntime.description: What the Harness needs from the Runtime to start. `node`: the Runtime runs `entry` with its bundled Node 22. `binary`: the Harness ships its own executables.

node.description: Node major the Runtime supplies. Required when kind is `node`; only `22` exists in P0.

userInterface.title: UserInterface
userInterface.description: UI Kind and its options. `path`, `readyTimeoutSeconds` and `window` apply to `web` only.

path.description: Path the Runtime opens on the Harness's local server. Starts with a single `/`.

readyTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds the Runtime waits for the port to accept connections.

window.title: WindowHints
window.description: Initial window size hints, in pixels.

models.title: Models
models.description: The Model Slots the Harness uses.

slots.title: ModelSlots
slots.description: Model Slots by name. `default` is mandatory; at most 8 Slots.

modelSlot.title: ModelSlot
modelSlot.description: A Model Slot. The Harness asks the Model Gateway for it by name; the User decides which model fills it.

description.description: What the Harness uses this Slot for.

recommended.description: Recommended Models, in preference order: at most 5 `provider/model` ids, without duplicates.

modelRequirements.title: ModelRequirements
modelRequirements.description: Model Requirements: what the Model Slot needs from a model. An absent key means no requirement.

declaredPermissions.title: DeclaredPermissions
declaredPermissions.description: Declared Permissions. All three keys are required. Informational in P0: shown for consent, not enforced.

scope.description: `none`: only its Data Directory. `workspace`: the chosen Workspace. `home`: anywhere under the User's home. `paths`: the listed paths.

paths.description: Explicit paths (`~` allowed). Required and non-empty when scope is `paths`.

networkPermission.title: NetworkPermission
networkPermission.description: Either `domains` (a list, possibly empty) or `any: true`. Traffic to the Model Gateway is implied and not declared.

domains.description: At most 20 lower-case domain names, optionally prefixed with `*.`, without duplicates.
